title: Question
description: An open question about a person, agency or other thing

id.description: An auto-generated ID for the question (added as part of validation)

name.description: Set if the question is about a particular person

alias.description: If the question is about a specific alias

case_no.description: If the question is about a legal case

agency_id.description: Set if the question is about a particular agency

system_id.description: Set if the question is about a specific computer system

position_id.description: Set if the question is about a specific position

event_id.description: Set if the question is about a specific event

answer.description: If the question has been answered

answer_date.description: The date the answer was found

sources.description: A link to one or more sources if applicable
